hints.ignored: {{engine}} ignores the language setting: the model decides.
hints.whisperCppAuto: Whisper.cpp detects the language in each short chunk and can switch back and forth. Choose a language if you know it.

hints.parakeetCtcEnglishOnly: Parakeet CTC 110M is English-only. Use Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 for Russian and other supported languages.

you.description: Your microphone — used in online meetings

nativeTranslation.hint: Soniox translates while it transcribes, in the same stream.

target.followHint: Empty: uses the target language of the Translation settings.

pair.hint: Speech in either language is translated into the other; any other language is only transcribed. Made for in-person meetings.
pair.incomplete: Pick both languages to turn two-way translation on.
pair.unsupported: Soniox only takes languages with a two-letter code (zh, en…).

diarization.label: Speaker Diarization
diarization.hint: Separate speakers in in-person mode (supported by {{engines}})

sessions.title: Audio Sessions
sessions.noMatchingDevice: Could not find matching output device

meetingAudio.info: Dual-purpose audio: In online meetings, "You" captures your mic and "Them" captures remote audio via system loopback. In in-person meetings, both sources share the room microphone and speaker diarization separates voices.

useFor.label: Use for

reasons.needsInput: Only works with a microphone source.

useFor.swap: {{engine}} can only run on one source at a time. Use it for {{party}}? {{other}} will fall back to {{fallback}}.

models.title: {{engine}} Models
models.hint: Download a model, then click Activate to enable this provider.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.stored: API key verified and stored securely
apiKey.prompt: Enter your key and click Save & Test

azureRegion.title: Azure Region
azureRegion.hint: Azure region for your Speech Services resource (e.g., eastus, westeurope, southeastasia)

languages.title: Language
languages.hint: Each side can use its own language. Auto-detect works with the engines that support it.

connection.title: Connection
connection.noModel: No model downloaded. Download a model below first.

pause.title: New Line Pause Duration
pause.hint: Start a new transcript line after no words detected for this duration. Lower values create more lines; higher values create longer paragraphs. Applies to all STT providers.

smartFormat.label: Smart Format
smartFormat.description: Formats dates, times, numbers and adds paragraph breaks

interimResults.label: Interim Results
interimResults.description: Show partial transcripts as you speak (lower latency feel)

punctuate.label: Punctuation
punctuate.description: Add punctuation and capitalization to the transcript

vadEvents.label: VAD Events
vadEvents.description: Emit events when speech starts/ends (improves endpointing)

diarize.label: Tell remote speakers apart
diarize.description: Labels each person on the other side of the call (Speaker 1, 2…). Never applied to your mic.

numerals.label: Numerals
numerals.description: Convert spoken numbers to digits ("nine hundred" → "900")

endpointing.label: Endpointing
endpointing.hint: Returns transcript when this much silence is detected. 10–999ms gives best results.

keyterms.label: Keyterm Prompting
keyterms.hint: Boost recognition of specific words or phrases (product names, jargon). Up to 100 keyterms.
keyterms.empty: No keyterms — model uses default recognition

groq.title: Groq Whisper Settings
groq.batchHint: Batch mode — audio is accumulated and sent every {{seconds}}s. Expect {{min}}–{{max}}s total latency.

highAccuracy.label: High Accuracy
highAccuracy.description: Best model, longer 8s batches for context

batch.label: Batch Duration
batch.hint: Shorter = faster responses but less context per API call. Minimum billed: 10s.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.hint: Lower values give more consistent results. 0 is recommended for transcription.

hints.verboseJson: Includes segment/word timestamps, confidence scores, and no-speech probability
hints.text: Plain text output only — no metadata

segment.label: Segment Timestamps
segment.description: Include start/end times for each segment

word.label: Word Timestamps
word.description: Include start/end times for each word

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.hint: Guide transcription style, spelling, or context. Up to 224 tokens. Must match audio language.

dualPass.title: Transcription Tuning
dualPass.hint: Dual-pass: fast pass shows words immediately, correction pass refines. Changes apply instantly.

fastPass.label: Fast pass interval
fastPass.hint: Shorter = faster words but less accurate

pause.label: Pause for new line
pause.hint: Silence before starting a new transcript line

gpu.label: Use the GPU (Metal)
gpu.hint: Runs Whisper.cpp on the graphics chip on Macs; falls back to the CPU if that fails. Applies when transcription next starts.

codes.no_key: The server wants an API key: choose Bearer token and save one.

codes.not_found: Nothing found at this address (404). Check the version prefix, e.g. /v1.
codes.timeout: The server didn't answer in time.

soniox.okModels_one: The key works — {{count}} real-time model available.

soniox.noKey: Save your Soniox API key first.
soniox.unauthorized: Invalid API key (401). Check the key and its region.
soniox.forbidden: The key is valid but can't list models (403). Real-time recognition may still work.

openaiCompat.description: Sends audio to your own OpenAI-compatible transcription server: faster-whisper-server / speaches, vLLM, LocalAI…

baseUrl.hint: No /v1 is added automatically: type the address with the version prefix your server uses.

auth.noneHint: No API key is sent. Choose Bearer token if your server needs one.
auth.removeConfirm: A saved key is sent with every request. Remove it to send requests without a key?

model.label: Model
model.hint: The model id your server expects. Refresh lists the models the server has.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.hint: Hints for spelling and context. Write it in the language of the audio.

segment.label: Segment length
segment.hint: Longest audio sent in one request.

pauseSplit.label: Split on pause
pauseSplit.hint: Silence that ends a segment early.

timeout.label: Request timeout
timeout.hint: How long to wait for one transcription.

maxInFlight.label: Requests at once
maxInFlight.hint: Results always come back in order.

urlOverride.label: Full transcription URL
urlOverride.hint: For gateways with an unusual path: used instead of the address above for transcription. Empty: address + /audio/transcriptions.

responseFormat.label: Response format
responseFormat.hint: json works with most servers; text and verbose_json are understood too.

soniox.description: Real-time recognition with live translation in the same stream. Each side gets its own session.

key.label: API Key
key.savedPlaceholder: Saved — type a new key to replace it
key.saved: Saved securely on this computer. It's never shown again.

region.label: Region
region.hint: Choose the region of the Soniox project your key belongs to: a key only works in its own region.

model.label: Model
model.hint: Real-time model. Refresh lists the models your key can use.

endpointDelay.label: Endpoint delay
endpointDelay.hint: How long Soniox waits after speech stops before it ends the sentence. Subtitles work best around 1000–1500 ms.

endpointTuning.title: Sentence-end tuning (stt-rt-v5 only)
endpointTuning.note: Only stt-rt-v5 accepts these two. Other models reject the whole session (error 400) when either is set, so keep both on the server default with any other model.

endpointSensitivity.label: Endpoint sensitivity
endpointSensitivity.hint: How readily Soniox decides a sentence is over. Higher ends sentences sooner (more, shorter lines); lower waits longer before finalizing. The server default is 0.0.

latencyAdjustment.label: Endpoint latency adjustment
latencyAdjustment.hint: Cuts the wait before a sentence ends: a higher level is faster and gives more sentence ends, with slightly lower accuracy. Level 0 is no adjustment (the server default).

diarization.label: Tell remote speakers apart
diarization.hint: Labels each person on the other side (S1, S2…). Applies to Them only.

strictHints.label: Strict language hints
strictHints.hint: Keep the output to the chosen languages (best effort). Off: other languages are still recognized.

wsUrl.label: Custom WebSocket URL
wsUrl.hint: For a gateway. Empty: the region's address.

restUrl.label: Custom REST URL
restUrl.hint: For a gateway (key test and model list). Empty: the region's address.

extraParams.label: Extra start parameters (JSON)
extraParams.hint: A JSON object merged into the start message, for fields this version doesn't know yet. The key and the audio format are never taken from it.

errors.notObject: Must be a JSON object, e.g. {"context": …}.
errors.apiKey: Don't put api_key here: the key comes from the API Key field.

soniox.cost: Costs about $0.12 per hour for each side Soniox transcribes; translation adds output tokens.
